scope: KR historical launch and year-change configurations, selected high-volume used-car generations
classificationPolicy: Only engine-to-trim combinations explicitly stated in the inspected manufacturer-distributed body are included.
Publisher is the manufacturer; newswire.co.kr is the press-release host, not the manufacturer domain.
Publication dates are not treated as model years.
Unobserved generation codes and provider parent codes remain unresolved; model labels preserve marketing name/generation when needed.
No Cartesian product of optional design, drivetrain, transmission, seat, or package choices is generated.
This is a source-backed research collection, not a complete all-year vehicle master and not a production import.
